rows.summary: The first scoped detailed validator loaded eighteen unittest failure placeholders because its script execution path did not expose the repository package root; no substantive test received credit, the failed receipt was retained, and explicit root insertion recovered the same frozen selection.

A read-only status summary used PowerShell -like with question marks intended as literal Git status characters; wildcard interpretation falsely counted every staged line as untracked, and a StartsWith literal check recovered the exact zero-untracked result.
